requirements_summary: Use case: contract search and summarization for client documents; must support confidential PII-containing PDFs with redaction pipeline. Latency targets: conversational/chat response <200ms for single-turn search calls (edge case), typical batched summarization can be higher (<=2s). Throughput: modest (50-200 qps peaks not required initially). Cost sensitivity: prefers pay-as-you-go hosted API; wants Optimize suggestions for batching & quantization to reduce token spend. Model preferences: open/instruction-tuned models acceptable; must support deterministic rerank for search relevance. Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to smaller cheaper model for non-sensitive summarization tasks. Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, per-token audit logs, exportable logs, KMS for any stored keys, retention controls (180d+), US data residency.
